caption: The drawing depicts a full-length dress with a fitted, high neckline and puffed long sleeves that taper and gather at the wrists, finishing with lace-edged cuffs. The bodice features vertical decorative panels, likely lace, and a band around the waist that cinches the dress. Each sleeve is puffed at the shoulder and the lower arm, decorated with two bands at the elbow and wrist. Lace trim decorates the shoulders, upper bodice, and cuffs. The dress is patterned with small red and blue floral motifs distributed evenly over a light background. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller sketch labeled "Back View" which outlines the dress’s rear details, including the back closure and the continuation of the puffed sleeves and wide skirt. The lower right of the main drawing is signed with the name “Mary Humes.”
title: Doll Dress
